rationale: EDU gapped down ~4.87% with no news catalyst, making the move difficult to interpret directionally. Price has recovered sharply from the session low ($47.92) to $50.05, now at 87.5% of today's range and pressing against today's high ($50.36), but the bid-ask spread is 118 bps on thin volume (99K shares), creating unfavorable entry conditions.
